requirement: Product catalogue site, 5M page views a month, almost no writes, visitors across India.

aws.note: CloudFront in front of ALB/EC2 with S3 for static assets and RDS read replicas for a read-heavy mix. CloudFront is the defining component of this class.

gcp.note: Cloud CDN is enabled ON the global external Application Load Balancer, so edge-cache and ingress-lb are one purchase but two roles.

azure.note: CORRECTED. This expected a WAF while citing basic-web-app, which has neither a gateway nor a firewall -- the fixture contradicted its own source. A WAF here is a real design option and this architecture offers it on the top tier; it is not what the cited reference contains, so it is not scored as missing.
